title: wp11_soft_key_new_rsa: no documented valid bit range
description: wolfp11/wp11_soft_key.h declares wp11_soft_key_new_rsa(int bits) with no documented valid range. wolfCrypt will reject invalid sizes at runtime, but the caller has no API contract to check against. Add a comment documenting the supported range (e.g., 1024-4096) and add an early-return guard in the implementation.
